description: Standardize spacing, border radii, and layout consistency (Issues 3, 17-21): Reduce border radii from 7→4 variants (rounded-lg/xl/2xl/full), standardize card padding to p-4/p-6, button gaps to gap-2, grid gaps to gap-4/6/8 per DESIGN_SYSTEM.md. Must run AFTER FEAT-001 typography changes to avoid conflicts.
steps: Read DESIGN_SYSTEM.md spacing and border-radius sections to confirm standards: rounded-xl for buttons/cards (primary), rounded-lg for inputs, rounded-2xl for large containers, rounded-full for pills
Update Navbar.tsx: Standardize all rounded-md to rounded-lg, verify gap-2 on button content, p-2.5 on IconButtons
Update Footer.tsx: Standardize column padding to consistent values, ensure grid gap-6 or gap-8
Update BookCard.tsx: Verify rounded-2xl on outer card, rounded-xl on inner elements, p-5 or p-6 padding (consolidate p-5 → p-6)
Update all home section components: Replace rounded-3xl with rounded-2xl where appropriate, standardize card padding to p-6 for large cards and p-4 for small
Update button gaps: Ensure all Button components use gap-2 (already in Button.tsx, verify callers don't override)
Update grid gaps: Home page sections should use gap-6 for default grids, gap-4 for compact, gap-8 for spacious layouts
Search for rounded-sm, rounded-md, rounded-3xl and replace: rounded-sm/md → rounded-lg, rounded-3xl → rounded-2xl
Verify AddToCart buttons in BookCard use the Button component from Button.tsx (variant='primary' size='sm') and not inline styles
acceptance_criteria: Border radius count is 4 or fewer distinct values (rounded-lg/xl/2xl/full)
All card padding is standardized to p-4 (small) or p-6 (large)
Grid gaps follow pattern: gap-4 (compact), gap-6 (default), gap-8 (spacious)
AddToCart buttons use unified Button component, not inline Tailwind classes
Visual consistency across all pages and components
verification: Run 'npm run dev' and navigate to http://localhost:3000/
Visually inspect all sections for consistent spacing and border radii
Check BookCard AddToCart buttons match the Button component styling
Use DevTools to search for 'rounded-sm', 'rounded-md', 'rounded-3xl' (should find none or minimal)
Verify grid layouts have consistent gap values
Navigate to /books and /cart to verify consistency across pages
